findings.title: Authentication Bypass via PHP Serialized Cookie Manipulation
findings.description: The application uses PHP serialized data stored in a base64-encoded 'creds' cookie for authentication. By manipulating the cookie value to set the password field to a boolean true (b:1), the authentication check is bypassed due to PHP's loose type comparison (== instead of ===). This allows any attacker to authenticate as admin without knowing the actual password.

reproduction.expected: Response contains 'Welcome Admin' and the flag
